s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with painful nodules and ulceration in the groin area, with a history of intertrigo and recent development of bright red, burning nodules
salient_findings: Bright red, burning and painful nodules around the scrotum
Epidermal ulceration overlying a diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies
key_facts: 3-month history of intertrigo involving the groin
Treatment with clotrimazole cream, 1%, and hydrocortisone cream, 1% initially improved the condition
Development of bright red, burning and painful nodules around the scrotum after initial improvement
Medical history includes prostate cancer, hypertension, anxiety disorder, hyperlipidemia, gastroesophageal reflux disease, and diverticulosis
Current medications include omeprazole, alprazolam, amlodipine besylate, atenolol, simvastatin, and valsartan
Two symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules present in the right and left inguinal folds adjacent to the scrotum
Histopathological examination showed epidermal ulceration and diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies were highlighted with iron (Prussian blue) and calcium (Von Kossa) stains
Tissue culture results included negative fungus culture, negative atypical mycobacteria culture, and positive bacterial culture for E. coli

shortlist.label: Malakoplakia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies and histiocytic proliferation in the histopathological examination

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes and presence of intracytoplasmic inclusions

shortlist.label: Necrobiotic xanthogranuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Calcium deposits and histiocytic proliferation with background plasma cells and neutrophils

shortlist.label: Granuloma inguinale
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerated nodule with sheeted dermal proliferation and presence of plasma cells and neutrophils

shortlist.label: Histiocytosis X
shortlist.why_kept: Histiocytic proliferation with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and presence of intracytoplasmic inclusions

raw.rationale: The presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, which are pathognomonic for Malakoplakia, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic radiologic findings and histiocytic infiltration pattern

rejected.label: Necrobiotic xanthogranuloma
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic necrobiotic granulomas and Touton giant cells

rejected.label: Granuloma inguinale
rejected.why: Negative bacterial culture for typical causative agents and absence of characteristic donovan bodies

rejected.label: Histiocytosis X
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic Langerhans cell proliferation and absence of Birbeck granules
